Use case: ui-mockup theme edit. The attached light-mode image is the EXACT EDIT TARGET, previously reviewed. Produce a DARK MODE VERSION of that same screen, not a redesign. Preserve the complete composition, positions, widths, typographic hierarchy, icons, every Spanish label, every fictitious data value, active sidebar item, disabled/locked states, warnings, date 13 oct 2026, and all controls. Do not add elements. Do not remove or rewrite text. Same aspect ratio and full frame, no crop or device frame. Translate colors into a polished, calm institutional dark theme: base canvas #101918, sidebar #091412, elevated surfaces #192522, inset fields #111D1A, subtle borders #30413B, primary text #F0F5F1, secondary text #ABBAB2. Primary actions mint #80D6AE with very dark #10281D labels; selected navigation #274F3E with pale mint #D3F7E4; selected rows #213D31; green active statuses #86D6AE. Amber warning background #35291A, border #765831, bright amber #F1C77E with cream text. Neutral disabled surfaces #26332E and clearly readable muted text. Keep subtle separation between background/surface/input. Avoid pure-black-on-black, neon glow, gradients, glass, unnecessary shadows. Recolor all original white/light panels and form fields; no unconverted white rectangle. All text must remain comfortably readable, including tiny helper text. Preserve labels indicating 'Vista de diseño', 'Datos ficticios', 'Sin conexión', future scope, disabled integration and AI disclosure. This is a static proposal, not production. Keep 'CRM CBN' plain typography, no new brand logo. Opaque background.
